## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: filter_bridge_events skips filtering entirely when bridge_env_id is empty (back-compat pass-through), unit-tested with bridge_env_id=\"\" and a mix of env_id=\"\" and env_id=\"real-uuid\" events

## What
Modify plugins/dso/scripts/bridge/_outbound_api.py to add an early-return guard in filter_bridge_events: when bridge_env_id is empty/falsy, return all events unchanged.

## File to modify
plugins/dso/scripts/bridge/_outbound_api.py lines 78-94

## Implementation
Change filter_bridge_events from:

def filter_bridge_events(
    events: list[dict[str, Any]], bridge_env_id: str
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    \"\"\"Filter out events whose env_id matches the bridge env ID.\"\"\"
    filtered: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for e in events:
        ...

To:

def filter_bridge_events(
    events: list[dict[str, Any]], bridge_env_id: str
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    \"\"\"Filter out events whose env_id matches the bridge env ID.
    
    When bridge_env_id is empty, skips filtering for back-compat — pre-migration
    events have env_id='' and must not be filtered when the bridge has no env_id set.
    \"\"\"
    if not bridge_env_id:
        return list(events)
    filtered: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for e in events:
        ...

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] filter_bridge_events returns all events when bridge_env_id is empty
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/scripts/test_bridge_outbound.py::test_filter_bridge_events_back_compat_when_bridge_env_id_empty -v 2>&1 | grep -q \"PASSED\"
- [ ] Existing filter_bridge_events tests still pass
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/scripts/test_bridge_outbound.py::test_bridge_env_filter_skips_bridge_originated_events -v 2>&1 | grep -q \"PASSED\"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Implement filter_bridge_events back-compat: pass through all events when bridge_env_id is empty
